data.name: Sudhakar
data.gender_notes: Sudhakar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sudha means purity and Kar means doer. Thus, Sudhakar is a name given to one who has good knowledge or is a learned man. The name Sudhakar carries the meaning “One who has good knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sudhakar usually hope their child will grow to embody one who has good knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name is believed to bring wisdom, knowledge, and intelligence to the bearer. It is also believed to be a name of a person who is pure in thoughts and actions.
data.etymology: Sudhakar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who has good knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sudhakar total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
